metaDescription: Order custom adjustable lanyards for your team or event. Perfect for IDs, keys, and phones. Bulk pricing at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Adjustable lanyards let you set the drop length to suit different users or situations—ideal for trade shows where attendees come in all sizes, or for safety managers who need a breakaway option at a specific length. Choose from polyester, cotton, or woven styles, and add your logo with screen printing, dye sublimation, or full-color imprint. The adjustable cord makes them versatile for IDs, keys, or phone holders.
heroAltText: Custom adjustable lanyards with printed logos and metal clips for holding IDs and keys.
